 # The directly indexed low-degree game
 
 The low-degree game used by the Pauli-basis combining argument is needed in
 dimension `2 * m + 2`.  The existing conditionally linear game represents a
 coordinate index by an equally sized fiber in the scalar field and therefore
 requires the dimension to divide the field size.  This file gives the separate
 directly indexed variant which samples that index directly.
 
 The geometric line carrier records the sampled coordinate, and line evaluation
 uses an `Option` outcome rather than assigning a value when a point does not
 determine one.  The game retains the point, axis-line, and diagonal-line answer
 formats and the nine ordered type branches of the original low-degree game.
 
 The `Transport` modules relate the direct game to the seed-indexed game and to
 the low individual degree test: `Transport.Correspondence`
 identifies coordinates, answers, and the question law of the two QPBT
 presentations; `Transport.SeedFiber` dilates a seed-indexed strategy to a
 direct strategy by a correlated residue register, and `Transport.SeedFiberValue`
 shows that the dilation preserves the value exactly; `Transport.Questions`
 reads LDT lines as canonical direct questions and rebases direct answers;
 `Transport.Strategy` reads one coordinate of a projective direct strategy as
 an LDT projective strategy, with exact Born-weight formulas for both
 constructions; `Transport.Consistency` reexpresses the three
 single-polynomial LDT consistency relations in direct coordinates, the first
 two at a fixed tuple coordinate; and
 `Transport.BranchComparison`, `Transport.DiagonalRecursion`, and
 `Transport.PassConversion` convert a value bound of the direct game into the
 pass hypothesis of the low individual degree theorem for every
 coordinate strategy.  `GameValue` supplies the rejection calculus relating the
 direct value to the LDT branch weights.  `Transport.Error` carries the
 scalar half of the transport: the auxiliary sampling parameter with which
 the low individual degree theorem is applied, bounds on the three terms of its
 error function, and the absorption of the resulting simultaneous-measurement
 estimate into the error function of `lem:ld-soundness`; and
 `Transport.Simultaneous` applies that theorem to every coordinate, carries
 the Schwartz--Zippel collision estimate to the direct polynomial
 representatives, and proves the polynomial-tuple conclusion of
 `lem:ld-soundness` for simultaneity parameter `1`.  It also records why the
 coordinate conclusions do not determine simultaneous measurements for larger
 parameters.  `Transport.PointAgreement` reads the point-agreement branch of
 either game as a consistency estimate, and `SeedIndexedSoundness` transports
 the polynomial-tuple conclusions back to the seed-indexed game `ldGame` by
 compressing the correlated residue register, recovering the global polynomial
 relation from the two point relations and the point-agreement branch.
 
 For a general simultaneity parameter, the reduction introduces the combined
 parameters `DirectLdParams.combined`, of dimension `m + k` and simultaneity
 parameter `1`; the combining map on polynomial tuples and its individual-degree
 bound; the substitution recovering the components of a combined polynomial,
 which exhibits the combining map as injective; and the Schwartz--Zippel
 collision estimate for two linear forms in the combining variables; and the
 combined strategy itself, which answers every question of the combined game by
 measuring one question of the original strategy and relabelling its outcome,
 together with its projectivity, the identification of the measured questions on
 each sample of the combined game, and the transport of its value.  The recovery
 of the components of a combined outcome costs `(m + k) d / q` in the two point

 the scalar estimate absorbs the resulting error into the error function of
 `lem:ld-soundness`; see
 `blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex`, the subsection on the combining
 reduction.

 The underlying game is blueprint
 `def:ld-game`, with source origin
 `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
 The need for the directly indexed repair in Chapter 15 is explained around
 blueprint
 `rem:qld-4-7-divisibility` and in
 `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-dimension-divisibility.tex`.

 This module bounds the probability that two distinct coefficient vectors give
 the same value at a uniformly sampled affine parameter.  It uses the existing
 coefficient-polynomial representation and Mathlib's univariate root count.

 private theorem linePolynomialOfCoefficients_injective_at_degree
     {K : Type*} [Field K] (degree : ℕ) :
     Function.Injective
       (linePolynomialOfCoefficients (K := K) (c := degree)) := by
   classical
   intro a b hab
   funext i
   have hcoeff := congrArg (fun p : Polynomial K => p.coeff i.val) hab
   simp only [linePolynomialOfCoefficients, Polynomial.finsetSum_coeff,
     Polynomial.coeff_C_mul_X_pow] at hcoeff
   have ha : (∑ j, if i.val = j.val then a j else 0) = a i := by
     simpa only [Fin.ext_iff] using Fintype.sum_ite_eq i a
   have hb : (∑ j, if i.val = j.val then b j else 0) = b i := by
     simpa only [Fin.ext_iff] using Fintype.sum_ite_eq i b
   rw [ha, hb] at hcoeff
   exact hcoeff
 
 /-- Two distinct direct coefficient vectors of degree at most `degree` agree
 at a uniformly sampled parameter with probability at most `degree / q`.
 
+This is a Lean-only auxiliary. The cited paper passages describe the coefficient
+answer format and apply Schwartz-Zippel to a later multivariate collision term;
+they do not state this exact univariate averaging bound.
+
 The estimate has no hypothesis `degree < q`; when the displayed bound exceeds
 one it remains a valid, deliberately nontruncated root-count bound. -/
 theorem directCoefficientCollision_avg_le (D : DirectLdParams) (degree : ℕ)
     (a b : DirectDegPoly D degree) (hne : a ≠ b) :
     avgOver (uniformDistribution (DirectScalarQ D))
         (fun t => if evalCoefficient a t = evalCoefficient b t then
           (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤
       (degree : ℝ) / (D.q : ℝ) := by
   classical
   let p := linePolynomialOfCoefficients a
   let p' := linePolynomialOfCoefficients b
   have hpoly_ne : p ≠ p' := by
     intro hpoly
     exact hne (linePolynomialOfCoefficients_injective_at_degree degree hpoly)
   let collisionSet : Finset (DirectScalarQ D) :=
     Finset.univ.filter fun t => evalCoefficient a t = evalCoefficient b t
   have hcollision_card : collisionSet.card ≤ degree := by
     have hsub_ne : p - p' ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hpoly_ne
     have hsubset : collisionSet.val ⊆ (p - p').roots := by
       intro t ht
       have heval : p.eval t = p'.eval t := by
         simpa [collisionSet, p, p', linePolynomialOfCoefficients_eval] using ht
       apply (Polynomial.mem_roots hsub_ne).2
       rw [Polynomial.IsRoot.def, Polynomial.eval_sub, sub_eq_zero]
       exact heval
     have hroot_card := Polynomial.card_le_degree_of_subset_roots
       (p := p - p') (Z := collisionSet) hsubset
     have hdegree : (p - p').natDegree ≤ max p.natDegree p'.natDegree := by
       simpa [sub_eq_add_neg, Polynomial.natDegree_neg] using
         (Polynomial.natDegree_add_le p (-p'))
     exact hroot_card.trans <| hdegree.trans <| max_le
       (linePolynomialOfCoefficients_natDegree_le a)
       (linePolynomialOfCoefficients_natDegree_le b)
   calc
     avgOver (uniformDistribution (DirectScalarQ D))
         (fun t => if evalCoefficient a t = evalCoefficient b t then
           (1 : ℝ) else 0) =
         (collisionSet.card : ℝ) /
           Fintype.card (DirectScalarQ D) := by
       calc
         avgOver (uniformDistribution (DirectScalarQ D))
             (fun t => if evalCoefficient a t = evalCoefficient b t then
               (1 : ℝ) else 0) =
             ∑ t : DirectScalarQ D,
               if evalCoefficient a t = evalCoefficient b t then
                 (1 / Fintype.card (DirectScalarQ D) : ℝ) else 0 := by
           simp [avgOver, uniformDistribution]
         _ = ∑ _t ∈ collisionSet,
               (1 / Fintype.card (DirectScalarQ D) : ℝ) := by
           rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
         _ = (collisionSet.card : ℝ) /
               Fintype.card (DirectScalarQ D) := by
           simp [div_eq_mul_inv]
     _ ≤ (degree : ℝ) / Fintype.card (DirectScalarQ D) := by
       exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by exact_mod_cast hcollision_card) (by positivity)
     _ = (degree : ℝ) / (D.q : ℝ) := by
       rw [card_directScalarQ]
 
 end
 
 end MIPStarRE.QPBT

+# Extended direct coefficient-collision loss
+
+This module compares the sum of the axis and diagonal coefficient-collision
+losses at the extended directly indexed parameters with the original `m*d/q`
+ratio.
+
+## References
+
+- `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:331-344`
+- `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1595-1603`

+
+namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
+
+/-- The axis loss `d/q` plus the diagonal loss `(2m+2)d/q` at the extended
+direct parameters is at most five times the original loss `md/q`.
+
+This is a Lean-only scalar auxiliary for combining the two coefficient-POVM
+consistency estimates. It uses only admissibility of the original parameters. -/
+theorem extendedDirectLd_coefficientCollisionLoss_le_five_mul
+    (P : AdmissibleParams) :
+    ((P.extendedDirectLd.d : ℝ) +
+        (P.extendedDirectLd.m * P.extendedDirectLd.d : ℝ)) /
+        (P.extendedDirectLd.q : ℝ) ≤
+      5 * ((P.m * P.d : ℝ) / (P.q : ℝ)) := by
+  have hm : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (P.m : ℝ) := by
+    exact_mod_cast P.one_le_m
+  have hqNat : 0 < P.q := by
+    rcases P.hq with ⟨k, _, hk⟩
+    rw [hk]
+    exact Nat.pow_pos (by decide)
+  have hq : (0 : ℝ) < (P.q : ℝ) := by
+    exact_mod_cast hqNat
+  change ((P.d : ℝ) + ((2 * P.m + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (P.d : ℝ)) /
+      (P.q : ℝ) ≤ 5 * ((P.m : ℝ) * (P.d : ℝ) / (P.q : ℝ))
+  push_cast
+  rw [show 5 * ((P.m : ℝ) * (P.d : ℝ) / (P.q : ℝ)) =
+    (5 * ((P.m : ℝ) * (P.d : ℝ))) / (P.q : ℝ) by ring]
+  apply (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hq).2
+  nlinarith [show (0 : ℝ) ≤ (P.d : ℝ) by positivity]
+
+end MIPStarRE.QPBT

 `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:970-989`. -/
 def finCombineEquiv (m : ℕ) :
     Fin (2 * m + 2) ≃ ((Fin m ⊕ Fin m) ⊕ Fin 2) :=
   (finCongr (by omega)).trans
     (finSumFinEquiv.symm.trans
       (Equiv.sumCongr finSumFinEquiv.symm (Equiv.refl (Fin 2))))

 def embX (m : ℕ) : Fin m → Fin (2 * m + 2) :=
   fun i => (finCombineEquiv m).symm (.inl (.inl i))
 
 /-- Embed a `Z`-block coordinate into the extended coordinate set. -/
 def embZ (m : ℕ) : Fin m → Fin (2 * m + 2) :=
   fun i => (finCombineEquiv m).symm (.inl (.inr i))
 
 /-- The extended coordinate occupied by the scalar `alpha`. -/
 def alphaVar (m : ℕ) : Fin (2 * m + 2) :=
   (finCombineEquiv m).symm (.inr 0)
 
 /-- The extended coordinate occupied by the scalar `beta`. -/
 def betaVar (m : ℕ) : Fin (2 * m + 2) :=
   (finCombineEquiv m).symm (.inr 1)
 
 /-- Project an extended point onto its `X` coordinate block. -/
 def projX {K : Type*} {m : ℕ} (u : Fin (2 * m + 2) → K) : Fin m → K :=
   fun i => u (embX m i)
 
 /-- Project an extended point onto its `Z` coordinate block. -/
 def projZ {K : Type*} {m : ℕ} (u : Fin (2 * m + 2) → K) : Fin m → K :=
   fun i => u (embZ m i)
 
 /-- Combine two multivariate polynomials by the formula
 `alpha * f(x) + beta * g(z)` from `def:combine-map`.
 
 Blueprint `def:combine-map`; paper
 `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:970-983`. -/
 noncomputable def combinePoly {K : Type*} [CommSemiring K] {m : ℕ}
     (f g : MvPolynomial (Fin m) K) : MvPolynomial (Fin (2 * m + 2)) K :=
   MvPolynomial.X (alphaVar m) * MvPolynomial.rename (embX m) f +
     MvPolynomial.X (betaVar m) * MvPolynomial.rename (embZ m) g

     (f g : MvPolynomial (Fin m) K) (u : Fin (2 * m + 2) → K) :
     MvPolynomial.eval u (combinePoly f g) =
       u (alphaVar m) * MvPolynomial.eval (projX u) f +
         u (betaVar m) * MvPolynomial.eval (projZ u) g := by
   change MvPolynomial.eval u (combinePoly f g) =
     u (alphaVar m) * MvPolynomial.eval (u ∘ embX m) f +
       u (betaVar m) * MvPolynomial.eval (u ∘ embZ m) g
   simp [combinePoly, MvPolynomial.eval_rename]

+/-!
+# Averaged affine coarse-graining of complete operator families
+
+Uniform scalar coefficients give collision probability `1 / card K` for
+distinct pairs over a finite field. Expanding the squared state-dependent
+distance therefore proves contraction when the two operator families have
+the same total operator. The placement lemmas apply this identity to the
+complete point measurements and to both ordered measurement products.
+
+## References
+
+This is the finite-dimensional calculation used for the coarse-graining in
+`lem:qld-4-12`, `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:993-1018`.
+The operator-family contraction is a formalization-only auxiliary lemma.
+-/

+
+namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
+
+open MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
+open MIPStarRE.Quantum
+
+noncomputable section
+
+private theorem avgOver_uniform_eq_indicator {K : Type*}
+    [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K] [Nonempty K] (x : K) :
+    avgOver (uniformDistribution K) (fun y => if y = x then (1 : ℝ) else 0) =
+      (Fintype.card K : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
+  rw [avgOver_uniform_eq_inv_card_mul_sum]
+  simp
+
+private theorem affine_collision_average {K : Type*}
+    [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
+    (p p' : K × K) :
+    avgOver (uniformDistribution (K × K)) (fun coefficients =>
+      if coefficients.1 * p.1 + coefficients.2 * p.2 =
+          coefficients.1 * p'.1 + coefficients.2 * p'.2 then (1 : ℝ) else 0) =
+      if p = p' then 1 else (Fintype.card K : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
+  classical
+  calc
+    avgOver (uniformDistribution (K × K)) (fun coefficients =>
+        if coefficients.1 * p.1 + coefficients.2 * p.2 =
+            coefficients.1 * p'.1 + coefficients.2 * p'.2 then (1 : ℝ) else 0) =
+        avgOver (uniformDistribution K) (fun alpha =>
+          avgOver (uniformDistribution K) (fun beta =>
+            if alpha * p.1 + beta * p.2 = alpha * p'.1 + beta * p'.2 then
+              (1 : ℝ) else 0)) := by
+                simpa only using
+                  (avgOver_uniform_prod (α := K) (β := K) (fun alpha beta =>
+                    if alpha * p.1 + beta * p.2 = alpha * p'.1 + beta * p'.2 then
+                      (1 : ℝ) else 0))
+    _ = if p = p' then 1 else (Fintype.card K : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
+      by_cases hp : p = p'
+      · subst p'
+        simp [avgOver_uniform_const]
+      · rw [if_neg hp]
+        by_cases hfirst : p.1 = p'.1
+        · have hsecond : p.2 ≠ p'.2 := by
+            intro h
+            exact hp (Prod.ext hfirst h)
+          have hdiff : p.2 - p'.2 ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hsecond
+          calc
+        avgOver (uniformDistribution K) (fun alpha =>
+            avgOver (uniformDistribution K) (fun beta =>
+              if alpha * p.1 + beta * p.2 = alpha * p'.1 + beta * p'.2 then
+                (1 : ℝ) else 0)) =
+            avgOver (uniformDistribution K) (fun _ =>
+              avgOver (uniformDistribution K) (fun beta =>
+                if beta = 0 then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) := by
+              apply avgOver_congr
+              intro alpha
+              apply avgOver_congr
+              intro beta
+              congr 1
+              apply propext
+              constructor
+              · intro h
+                rw [hfirst] at h
+                have : beta * (p.2 - p'.2) = 0 := by
+                  linear_combination h
+                exact (mul_eq_zero.mp this).resolve_right hdiff
+              · intro h
+                subst beta
+                simp [hfirst]
+            _ = _ := by rw [avgOver_uniform_eq_indicator, avgOver_uniform_const]
+        · have hdiff : p.1 - p'.1 ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hfirst
+          calc
+        avgOver (uniformDistribution K) (fun alpha =>
+            avgOver (uniformDistribution K) (fun beta =>
+              if alpha * p.1 + beta * p.2 = alpha * p'.1 + beta * p'.2 then
+                (1 : ℝ) else 0)) =
+            avgOver (uniformDistribution K) (fun beta =>
+              avgOver (uniformDistribution K) (fun alpha =>
+                if alpha = beta * (p'.2 - p.2) / (p.1 - p'.1) then
+                  (1 : ℝ) else 0)) := by

+              apply avgOver_congr
+              intro beta
+              apply avgOver_congr
+              intro alpha
+              congr 1
+              apply propext
+              exact calc
+                alpha * p.1 + beta * p.2 = alpha * p'.1 + beta * p'.2 ↔
+                    alpha * (p.1 - p'.1) = beta * (p'.2 - p.2) := by
+                      constructor <;> intro h <;> linear_combination h

+                      (fun _ => (Fintype.card K : ℝ)⁻¹) := by
+                        apply avgOver_congr
+                        intro beta

+            question.2.1 * p.1 + question.2.2 * p.2 = c), B question.1 p)

+  unfold opFamilyDistSq

+    avgOver (uniformDistribution (X × (K × K))) (fun question =>
+        ∑ c : K,
+          ‖applyOperatorToState
+            ((∑ p ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun p =>
+                question.2.1 * p.1 + question.2.2 * p.2 = c), A question.1 p) -
+              ∑ p ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun p =>
+                question.2.1 * p.1 + question.2.2 * p.2 = c), B question.1 p) ψ‖ ^ 2) =
+        avgOver (uniformDistribution X) (fun x =>
+          avgOver (uniformDistribution (K × K)) (fun coefficients =>
+            ∑ c : K,
+              ‖applyOperatorToState
+                ((∑ p ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun p =>
+                    coefficients.1 * p.1 + coefficients.2 * p.2 = c), A x p) -
+                  ∑ p ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun p =>
+                    coefficients.1 * p.1 + coefficients.2 * p.2 = c), B x p) ψ‖ ^ 2)) := by
+          simpa only using (avgOver_uniform_prod (α := X) (β := K × K)
+            (fun x coefficients =>
+              ∑ c : K,
+                ‖applyOperatorToState
+                  ((∑ p ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun p =>
+                      coefficients.1 * p.1 + coefficients.2 * p.2 = c), A x p) -
+                    ∑ p ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun p =>
+                      coefficients.1 * p.1 + coefficients.2 * p.2 = c), B x p) ψ‖ ^ 2))

+        ∑ p, ‖applyOperatorToState (A x p - B x p) ψ‖ ^ 2) := by

+                  coefficients.1 * p.1 + coefficients.2 * p.2 = c), v p‖ ^ 2) := by

+/-- Register placement preserves the total of a finite operator family. -/
+theorem place_sum {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ}
+    (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) (p : Placement) {α : Type*} [Fintype α]
+    (A : α → Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p.side)) :
+    S.place p (∑ a, A a) = ∑ a, S.place p (A a) := by
+  classical
+  ext i j
+  cases p <;> simp [ProjectiveSetting.place, Matrix.sum_apply,
+    Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
+
+private theorem place_one {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ}
+    (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) (p : Placement) :
+    S.place p (1 : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p.side)) = 1 := by
+  ext i j
+  cases p <;> simp only [ProjectiveSetting.place, Matrix.one_apply, Prod.ext_iff]
+  all_goals split_ifs <;> aesop
+
+/-- A complete measurement remains complete after register placement. -/
+theorem sum_placed_measurement_eq_one {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ}
+    (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) (p : Placement) {α : Type*} [Fintype α]
+    (M : Measurement α (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p.side)) :
+    (∑ a, S.place p (M.effect a)) = 1 := by
+  rw [← place_sum, M.sum_eq_one, place_one]
+
+/-- Ordered products of two complete measurements have total identity after placement. -/
+theorem sum_placed_measurement_products_eq_one
+    {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ}
+    (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) (p : Placement)
+    {α β : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype β]
+    (M : Measurement α (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p.side))
+    (N : Measurement β (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p.side)) :
+    (∑ ab : α × β, S.place p (M.effect ab.1 * N.effect ab.2)) = 1 := by
+  rw [← place_sum, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
+  have hlocal : (∑ a : α, ∑ b : β, M.effect a * N.effect b) = 1 := by
+    calc
+    (∑ a : α, ∑ b : β, M.effect a * N.effect b) =
+        ∑ a : α, M.effect a * ∑ b : β, N.effect b := by
+          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+          intro a _
+          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
+    _ = (∑ a : α, M.effect a) * ∑ b : β, N.effect b := by rw [Finset.sum_mul]
+    _ = 1 := by rw [M.sum_eq_one, N.sum_eq_one, one_mul]
+  rw [hlocal, place_one]
+
+end

+import MIPStarRE.QPBT.Combining.ExtendedLineGame.StateTransport
+
+/-!
+# Nonnegativity of combining-witness errors
+
+This module derives nonnegativity of the error parameters supplied with the
+combined point and extended line witnesses.  The point conclusion follows from
+nonnegativity of state-dependent squared distance.  The line conclusion uses
+the genuine bipartite POVMs underlying the completed line-point defect.
+
+## References
+
+- `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:689-709`
+- `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1020-1034`
+- Blueprint `lem:qld-4-10` and `lem:qld-4-13`.
+- Issue #335.
+-/
+
+open scoped BigOperators MatrixOrder ComplexOrder
+
+set_option synthInstance.maxSize 400
+
+namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
+
+open MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
+open MIPStarRE.Quantum
+
+noncomputable section
+
+/-- This formalization-only auxiliary records that the error parameter of a supplied
+`CombinedPointsWitness` is nonnegative. It supports `lem:qld-4-10`, paper lines
+689--709, and does not construct or assert existence of the witness. -/
+theorem CombinedPointsWitness.delta_nonneg {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon deltaQ : ℝ}
+    {setting : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon}
+    (points : CombinedPointsWitness setting deltaQ) :
+    0 ≤ deltaQ := by
+  exact le_trans
+    (DistanceCalculus.opFamilyDistSq_nonneg
+      (uniformDistribution
+        ((Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) × (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)))
+      (fun xz ab => setting.place .AA' ((points.Q .alice xz.1 xz.2).effect ab))
+      (fun xz ab => setting.place .BA'' ((points.Q .bob xz.1 xz.2).effect ab))
+      setting.psiHat)
+    (points.self_consistent .AA' .BA'' trivial)
+
+namespace ExtendedLineGame
+
+variable {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon deltaQ deltaL : ℝ}
+variable {setting : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon}
+variable {points : CombinedPointsWitness setting deltaQ}
+
+/-- This formalization-only auxiliary records nonnegativity of the completed
+`AA'`--`BA''` line-point defect for a supplied `ExtendedLinesWitness`. It supports
+`lem:qld-4-13`, paper lines 1020--1034, by expressing the correlation terms as
+those of genuine POVMs on `pairState setting`; it does not construct the witness. -/
+theorem completedLinePointDefect_aaBa_nonneg
+    (lines : ExtendedLinesWitness setting points deltaL)
+    (mu : Distribution
+      (DirectLineDesc P.extendedDirectLd ×
+        (Fin P.extendedDirectLd.m → DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd))) :
+    0 ≤ completedLinePointDefect lines .AA' .BA'' mu := by
+  let lineMeasurement :
+      (DirectLineDesc P.extendedDirectLd ×
+        (Fin P.extendedDirectLd.m → DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd)) →
+        Measurement (Option (PauliScalar P)) (setting.ExpandedLocalSpace .alice) :=
+    fun sample =>
+      (lines.Qline .alice sample.1).postprocess
+        (fun coeffs => (directEvalOpt sample.1 sample.2 coeffs).map
+          (extendedDirectScalarEquiv P))
+  let pointMeasurement :
+      (DirectLineDesc P.extendedDirectLd ×
+        (Fin P.extendedDirectLd.m → DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd)) →
+        Measurement (Option (PauliScalar P)) (setting.ExpandedLocalSpace .bob) :=
+    fun sample =>
+      (points.Q .bob
+        (projX (directPointToPauli P sample.2))
+        (projZ (directPointToPauli P sample.2))).postprocess fun values =>
+          some (directPointToPauli P sample.2 (alphaVar P.m) * values.1 +
+            directPointToPauli P sample.2 (betaVar P.m) * values.2)
+  change 0 ≤ consistencyDefect mu
+    (fun sample answer => setting.place .AA' ((lineMeasurement sample).effect answer))
+    (fun sample answer => setting.place .BA'' ((pointMeasurement sample).effect answer))
+    setting.psiHat
+  unfold consistencyDefect avgOver
+  refine Finset.sum_nonneg fun sample _ =>
+    mul_nonneg (mu.nonnegative sample) ?_
+  refine Finset.sum_nonneg fun answerA _ => ?_
+  refine Finset.sum_nonneg fun answerB _ => ?_
+  by_cases hab : answerA = answerB
+  · simp [hab]
+  · simp only [hab, if_false, DistanceCalculus.consistency_term_eq_stateQForm]

+      ((lineMeasurement sample).effect answerA)
+      ((pointMeasurement sample).effect answerB)

+        ((lineMeasurement sample).pos answerA)).isHermitian
+      (Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp
+        ((pointMeasurement sample).pos answerB)).isHermitian]

+      (MIPStarRE.Quantum.kronecker_nonneg
+        ((lineMeasurement sample).pos answerA)
+        ((pointMeasurement sample).pos answerB))

+/-- This formalization-only auxiliary records that the error parameter of a supplied
+`ExtendedLinesWitness` is nonnegative. It supports `lem:qld-4-13`, paper lines
+1020--1034, and does not construct or assert existence of the witness. -/
+theorem ExtendedLinesWitness.delta_nonneg {P : AdmissibleParams}
+    {epsilon deltaQ deltaL : ℝ} {setting : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon}
+    {points : CombinedPointsWitness setting deltaQ}
+    (lines : ExtendedLinesWitness setting points deltaL) :
+    0 ≤ deltaL := by
+  exact le_trans
+    (ExtendedLineGame.completedLinePointDefect_aaBa_nonneg lines
+      (directLinePointDist P.extendedDirectLd))
+    lines.consistent_alice
+
+end
+
+end MIPStarRE.QPBT

+        DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd)
+    (values : Fin P.extendedDirectLd.k → DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd) :
+    directLdWinPredicate P.extendedDirectLd
+        (.dline, directLdMap P.extendedDirectLd .dline sample)
+        (.point, directLdMap P.extendedDirectLd .point sample)
+        (.dlinePolys coeffs) (.pointVals values) = true ↔
+      diagonalGameRead sample (.dlinePolys coeffs) = pointGameRead (.pointVals values) := by
+  let line := directDLineDescOf P.extendedDirectLd sample
+  have hmem : sample.point ∈ line.pointSet := by
+    simpa [line, DirectLineDesc.pointSet, directDLineDescOf,
+      DirectLineDesc.base, DirectLineDesc.direction] using
+      (mem_linePoints_lineRepMap
+        (directPrefixProjection sample.index sample.direction) sample.point)
+  constructor
+  · intro hwin
+    have heval : DirectEvaluatesTo line (coeffs onlyCoordinate) sample.point
+        (values onlyCoordinate) := by
+      refine ⟨hmem, ?_⟩
+      intro parameter hparameter
+      have hcondition : directDlinePointCondition P.extendedDirectLd
+          (directLdMap P.extendedDirectLd .dline sample)
+          (directLdMap P.extendedDirectLd .point sample) coeffs values := by
+        simpa [directLdWinPredicate, validDirectLdAnswer] using hwin
+      exact hcondition parameter (by
+        simpa [line, directDLineDescOf, directLdMap, DirectLineDesc.base,
+          DirectLineDesc.direction] using hparameter) onlyCoordinate
+    have hopt : directEvalOpt line sample.point (coeffs onlyCoordinate) =
+        some (values onlyCoordinate) :=
+      (directEvalOpt_eq_some_iff line sample.point (coeffs onlyCoordinate)
+        (values onlyCoordinate)).2 heval
+    simp [diagonalGameRead, pointGameRead, line, hopt]
+  · intro hread
+    have hopt : directEvalOpt line sample.point (coeffs onlyCoordinate) =
+        some (values onlyCoordinate) := by
+      cases h : directEvalOpt line sample.point (coeffs onlyCoordinate) with
+      | none => simp [diagonalGameRead, pointGameRead, line, h] at hread
+      | some value =>
+          have hvalue : value = values onlyCoordinate := by
+            apply (extendedDirectScalarEquiv P).injective
+            simpa [diagonalGameRead, pointGameRead, line, h] using hread
+          subst value
+          rfl
+    have heval := (directEvalOpt_eq_some_iff line sample.point
+      (coeffs onlyCoordinate) (values onlyCoordinate)).1 hopt
+    simp only [directLdWinPredicate, validDirectLdAnswer, Bool.and_self,
+      ↓reduceIte, decide_eq_true_eq]
+    intro parameter hparameter index
+    have hindex : index = onlyCoordinate := by
+      have hlt : index.val < 1 := index.isLt
+      have hzero : (onlyCoordinate (P := P)).val = 0 := rfl
+      apply Fin.ext
+      rw [hzero]
+      omega
+    subst index
+    exact heval.2 parameter (by
+      simpa [line, directDLineDescOf, directLdMap, DirectLineDesc.base,
+        DirectLineDesc.direction] using hparameter)

+private theorem diagonalGameRead_diagonalAnswer_eq
+    (sample : DirectLdSpace P.extendedDirectLd)
+    (coeffs : DirectDegPoly P.extendedDirectLd (P.m * P.d + 1)) :
+    diagonalGameRead sample (diagonalAnswer P coeffs) =
+      (directEvalOpt (directDLineDescOf P.extendedDirectLd sample) sample.point coeffs).map
+        (extendedDirectScalarEquiv P) := by
+  change (directEvalOpt (directDLineDescOf P.extendedDirectLd sample) sample.point
+      (diagonalRead P coeffs)).map (extendedDirectScalarEquiv P) = _
+  have heval (parameter : DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd) :
+      evalCoefficient (diagonalRead P coeffs) parameter = evalCoefficient coeffs parameter :=
+    diagonalRead_eval P coeffs parameter
+  apply congrArg (Option.map (extendedDirectScalarEquiv P))
+  cases hfull : directEvalOpt (directDLineDescOf P.extendedDirectLd sample)
+      sample.point coeffs with
+  | none =>
+      cases hdiagonal : directEvalOpt (directDLineDescOf P.extendedDirectLd sample)
+          sample.point (diagonalRead P coeffs) with
+      | none => rfl
+      | some answer =>
+          have hspec := (directEvalOpt_eq_some_iff _ _ _ _).1 hdiagonal
+          have hfull' : directEvalOpt (directDLineDescOf P.extendedDirectLd sample)
+              sample.point coeffs = some answer := by
+            apply (directEvalOpt_eq_some_iff _ _ _ _).2
+            exact ⟨hspec.1, fun parameter hparameter =>
+              (heval parameter).symm.trans (hspec.2 parameter hparameter)⟩
+          rw [hfull] at hfull'
+          contradiction
+  | some answer =>
+      have hspec := (directEvalOpt_eq_some_iff _ _ _ _).1 hfull
+      have hdiagonal : directEvalOpt (directDLineDescOf P.extendedDirectLd sample)
+          sample.point (diagonalRead P coeffs) = some answer := by
+        apply (directEvalOpt_eq_some_iff _ _ _ _).2
+        exact ⟨hspec.1, fun parameter hparameter =>
+          (heval parameter).trans (hspec.2 parameter hparameter)⟩
+      rw [hdiagonal]

+private theorem diagonal_completed_defect_eq_read_defect
+    (lines : ExtendedLinesWitness setting points deltaL) :
+    completedLinePointDefect lines .AA' .BA''
+        (directDLinePointDist P.extendedDirectLd) =
+      consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (DirectLdSpace P.extendedDirectLd))
+        (fun sample answer => heteroKron
+          (((answerMeasurement lines .alice
+            (.dline, directLdMap P.extendedDirectLd .dline sample)).postprocess
+              (diagonalGameRead sample)).effect answer) 1)
+        (fun sample answer => heteroKron 1
+          (((answerMeasurement lines .bob
+            (.point, directLdMap P.extendedDirectLd .point sample)).postprocess
+              pointGameRead).effect answer))
+        (pairState setting) := by
+  unfold completedLinePointDefect consistencyDefect

+  apply avgOver_congr
+  intro sample
+  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+  intro answerA _
+  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+  intro answerB _
+  by_cases hab : answerA = answerB

+    rw [diagonal_read_effect lines sample answerA, point_read_effect lines sample answerB,
+      DistanceCalculus.placed_product_stateQForm_eq]
+    symm
+    apply stateQForm_pairState_eq_AA'_BA''
+    · exact (Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp
+        (((lines.Qline .alice
+          (directDLineDescOf P.extendedDirectLd sample)).postprocess
+            (fun coeffs => (directEvalOpt
+              (directDLineDescOf P.extendedDirectLd sample) sample.point coeffs).map
+                (extendedDirectScalarEquiv P))).pos answerA)).isHermitian
+    · exact (Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp
+        (((points.Q .bob
+          (projX (directPointToPauli P sample.point))
+          (projZ (directPointToPauli P sample.point))).postprocess fun values =>
+            some (directPointToPauli P sample.point (alphaVar P.m) * values.1 +
+              directPointToPauli P sample.point (betaVar P.m) * values.2)).pos answerB)).isHermitian

+/-- The diagonal-line/point branch rejection of the supplied strategy is exactly
+the `AA'`--`BA''` completed line-point defect. This includes zero diagonal
+directions: failed completed evaluation remains the `none` outcome and
+contributes to rejection rather than being replaced by a scalar value. -/
+theorem dline_point_rejection_eq_completedLinePointDefect
+    (lines : ExtendedLinesWitness setting points deltaL) :
+    directLdBranchRejectionProbability P.extendedDirectLd (strategy lines)
+        (.dline, .point) =
+      completedLinePointDefect lines .AA' .BA''
+        (directDLinePointDist P.extendedDirectLd) := by

+    avgOver (uniformDistribution (DirectLdSpace P.extendedDirectLd))
+        (fun sample => directRejectedMass P.extendedDirectLd (strategy lines)
+          (.dline, directLdMap P.extendedDirectLd .dline sample)
+          (.point, directLdMap P.extendedDirectLd .point sample)) =
+        avgOver (uniformDistribution (DirectLdSpace P.extendedDirectLd))
+          (fun sample => outcomeEventWeight (strategy lines)
+            (.dline, directLdMap P.extendedDirectLd .dline sample)
+            (.point, directLdMap P.extendedDirectLd .point sample)
+            (fun answerA answerB =>
+              diagonalGameRead sample answerA ≠ pointGameRead answerB)) := by
+      apply avgOver_congr
+      exact diagonal_rejectedMass_eq_read_mismatch lines
+    _ = consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (DirectLdSpace P.extendedDirectLd))
+        (fun sample answer => heteroKron
+          (((answerMeasurement lines .alice
+            (.dline, directLdMap P.extendedDirectLd .dline sample)).postprocess
+              (diagonalGameRead sample)).effect answer) 1)
+        (fun sample answer => heteroKron 1
+          (((answerMeasurement lines .bob
+            (.point, directLdMap P.extendedDirectLd .point sample)).postprocess
+              pointGameRead).effect answer))
+        (pairState setting) := by
+      exact (WinImplications.consistencyDefect_postprocess_eq_mismatch
+        (uniformDistribution (DirectLdSpace P.extendedDirectLd)) (strategy lines)
+        (fun sample => (.dline, directLdMap P.extendedDirectLd .dline sample))
+        (fun sample => (.point, directLdMap P.extendedDirectLd .point sample))
+        diagonalGameRead (fun _ => pointGameRead)).symm
+    _ = completedLinePointDefect lines .AA' .BA''
+        (directDLinePointDist P.extendedDirectLd) :=
+      (diagonal_completed_defect_eq_read_defect lines).symm

 ## 3. The merge gate
 
 `pr_merge.py <number>` is the only path to `main`: never `git merge` to main,
 never push `main`. The merge is a REST `PUT …/pulls/{n}/merge` with the exact
 `sha` guard, issued by `gh_common.merge_pr` and verified against the merge
 commit's topology (two parents, the frozen head second), behind seven gates
 that refuse by default:
 
 1. the PR is open, unmerged and not a draft (`draft is False`, not merely
    falsy), and reports a head SHA, a head ref and a base ref;
 2. the primary worktree is clean and on the base, and the local branch tip
    equals the GitHub head SHA — the merge must be of the bytes built here;
 3. all eight `local-ci/<step>` contexts plus `local-ci/summary` are `success` on
    that exact SHA; a **missing** context blocks, because GitHub's combined state
    reads `success` for a commit carrying no statuses at all;
 4. that SHA's marker-bound `COMMENT` review (or one carried forward per
    review.md §13) carries `VERDICT: APPROVED`, or
    `COMMENTED` with zero unchecked findings, **and** `local-review/summary` is
    `success` there;
 5. no `CHANGES_REQUESTED` review stands on that head, from anyone;
 6. no live fix lock for the branch (`locks/fix-<branch>.lock`, running holder);
    the count of `merge-base..head` commits whose subject starts with a §1 fix
    prefix is printed for the record and is not a gate;
 7. every issue the PR body closes — all nine of GitHub's closing keywords, not
    just `Closes` — has no open sub-issue left.
 
 `--adjudicated` waives gate 4's adverse verdict and nothing else, and only when
 an exact-head `ADJUDICATION` comment backs it; gate 5 is never adjudicable.
 
 Afterwards a best-effort, non-fatal tail fast-forwards local `main` to the
 remote merge commit; branch and worktree cleanup keeps its safeguards (local
 dirt defers it with a warning).

 3. the merge commit names the adjudication and the issues created;
 4. `pr_merge.py --adjudicated` accepts it in place of a clean verdict, and
    only for the current head — a stale `head=` is a refusal.

 def _git(repo: Path, *args: str) -> str:
     proc = subprocess.run(["git", *args], cwd=str(repo), capture_output=True, text=True)
     if proc.returncode != 0:

     return proc.stdout.strip()

    85	              · intro h
    86	                subst beta
    87	                simp [hfirst]
    88	            _ = _ := by rw [avgOver_uniform_eq_indicator, avgOver_uniform_const]
    89	        · have hdiff : p.1 - p'.1 ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hfirst
    90	          calc
    91	        avgOver (uniformDistribution K) (fun alpha =>
    92	            avgOver (uniformDistribution K) (fun beta =>
    93	              if alpha * p.1 + beta * p.2 = alpha * p'.1 + beta * p'.2 then
    94	                (1 : ℝ) else 0)) =
    95	            avgOver (uniformDistribution K) (fun beta =>
    96	              avgOver (uniformDistribution K) (fun alpha =>
    97	                if alpha = beta * (p'.2 - p.2) / (p.1 - p'.1) then
    98	                  (1 : ℝ) else 0)) := by
    99	              rw [avgOver_uniform_comm]
   100	              apply avgOver_congr
   101	              intro beta
   102	              apply avgOver_congr
   103	              intro alpha
   104	              congr 1
   105	              apply propext
   106	              exact calc
   107	                alpha * p.1 + beta * p.2 = alpha * p'.1 + beta * p'.2 ↔
   108	                    alpha * (p.1 - p'.1) = beta * (p'.2 - p.2) := by
   109	                      constructor <;> intro h <;> linear_combination h
   110	                _ ↔ alpha = beta * (p'.2 - p.2) / (p.1 - p'.1) :=
   111	                  (eq_div_iff hdiff).symm
   112	            _ = _ := by
   113	              calc
   114	                avgOver (uniformDistribution K) (fun beta =>
   115	                    avgOver (uniformDistribution K) (fun alpha =>
   116	                      if alpha = beta * (p'.2 - p.2) / (p.1 - p'.1) then
   117	                        (1 : ℝ) else 0)) =
   118	                    avgOver (uniformDistribution K)
   119	                      (fun _ => (Fintype.card K : ℝ)⁻¹) := by
   120	                        apply avgOver_congr
   121	                        intro beta
   122	                        exact avgOver_uniform_eq_indicator _
   123	                _ = _ := avgOver_uniform_const _

   125	private theorem sum_fiber_norm_sq_eq_pair_sum
   126	    {Γ R ι : Type*} [Fintype Γ] [Fintype R] [DecidableEq R]
   127	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   128	    (f : Γ → R) (v : Γ → EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
   129	    (∑ r : R, ‖∑ g ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun g => f g = r), v g‖ ^ 2) =
   130	      ∑ g : Γ, ∑ g' : Γ,
   131	        if f g = f g' then (inner ℂ (v g) (v g')).re else 0 := by
   132	  classical
   133	  calc
   134	    (∑ r : R, ‖∑ g ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun g => f g = r), v g‖ ^ 2) =
   135	        ∑ r : R, ∑ g ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun g => f g = r),
   136	          ∑ g' ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun g' => f g' = r),
   137	            (inner ℂ (v g) (v g')).re := by
   138	              apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   139	              intro r _
   140	              simp only [@norm_sq_eq_re_inner ℂ, sum_inner, inner_sum, map_sum]
   141	              apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   142	              intro g _
   143	              apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   144	              intro g' _
   145	              exact inner_re_symm _ _
   146	    _ = ∑ r : R, ∑ g : Γ, ∑ g' : Γ,
   147	        if f g = r ∧ f g' = r then (inner ℂ (v g) (v g')).re else 0 := by
   148	          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   149	          intro r _
   150	          rw [Finset.sum_filter]
   151	          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   152	          intro g _
   153	          by_cases hg : f g = r
   154	          · rw [if_pos hg, Finset.sum_filter]
   155	            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   156	            intro g' _
   157	            by_cases hg' : f g' = r <;> simp [hg, hg']
   158	          · simp [hg]
   159	    _ = ∑ g : Γ, ∑ r : R, ∑ g' : Γ,
   160	        if f g = r ∧ f g' = r then (inner ℂ (v g) (v g')).re else 0 := by
   161	          rw [Finset.sum_comm]
   162	    _ = ∑ g : Γ, ∑ g' : Γ, ∑ r : R,
   163	        if f g = r ∧ f g' = r then (inner ℂ (v g) (v g')).re else 0 := by
   164	          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   165	          intro g _
   166	          rw [Finset.sum_comm]
   167	    _ = ∑ g : Γ, ∑ g' : Γ,
   168	        if f g = f g' then (inner ℂ (v g) (v g')).re else 0 := by
   169	          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   170	          intro g _
   171	          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   172	          intro g' _
   173	          by_cases hgg' : f g = f g'
   174	          · rw [if_pos hgg', Fintype.sum_eq_single (f g)]
   175	            · simp [hgg']
   176	            · intro r hr
   177	              simp [Ne.symm hr]
   178	          · rw [if_neg hgg']
   179	            apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
   180	            intro r _
   181	            simp only [ite_eq_right_iff]
   182	            intro h
   183	            exact (hgg' (h.1.trans h.2.symm)).elim

   185	private theorem avg_affine_fiber_norm_sq_le
   186	    {K ι : Type*} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
   187	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   188	    (v : K × K → EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) (hsum : ∑ p, v p = 0) :
   189	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (K × K)) (fun coefficients =>
   190	        ∑ c : K,
   191	          ‖∑ p ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun p =>
   192	            coefficients.1 * p.1 + coefficients.2 * p.2 = c), v p‖ ^ 2) ≤
   193	      ∑ p, ‖v p‖ ^ 2 := by
   194	  classical
   195	  let w : (K × K) → (K × K) → ℝ := fun p p' => (inner ℂ (v p) (v p')).re
   196	  let qinv : ℝ := (Fintype.card K : ℝ)⁻¹
   197	  have hall : (∑ p, ∑ p', w p p') = 0 := by
   198	    have h := sum_fiber_norm_sq_eq_pair_sum (fun _ : K × K => ()) v
   199	    simpa [w, hsum] using h.symm
   200	  have hdiag : (∑ p, w p p) = ∑ p, ‖v p‖ ^ 2 := by
   201	    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   202	    intro p _
   203	    exact (@norm_sq_eq_re_inner ℂ _ _ _ _ (v p)).symm
   204	  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ ∑ p, ‖v p‖ ^ 2 :=
   205	    Finset.sum_nonneg fun p _ => sq_nonneg _
   206	  have hqinv : 0 ≤ qinv := by positivity
   207	  calc
   208	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (K × K)) (fun coefficients =>
   209	        ∑ c : K,
   210	          ‖∑ p ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun p =>
   211	            coefficients.1 * p.1 + coefficients.2 * p.2 = c), v p‖ ^ 2) =
   212	        avgOver (uniformDistribution (K × K)) (fun coefficients =>
   213	          ∑ p, ∑ p', if
   214	            coefficients.1 * p.1 + coefficients.2 * p.2 =
   215	              coefficients.1 * p'.1 + coefficients.2 * p'.2 then w p p' else 0) := by
   216	            apply avgOver_congr
   217	            intro coefficients
   218	            exact sum_fiber_norm_sq_eq_pair_sum _ v
   219	    _ = ∑ p, ∑ p', avgOver (uniformDistribution (K × K)) (fun coefficients =>
   220	          if coefficients.1 * p.1 + coefficients.2 * p.2 =
   221	              coefficients.1 * p'.1 + coefficients.2 * p'.2 then w p p' else 0) := by
   222	            rw [avgOver_sum]
   223	            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   224	            intro p _
   225	            rw [avgOver_sum]
   226	    _ = ∑ p, ∑ p', if p = p' then w p p' else qinv * w p p' := by
   227	            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   228	            intro p _
   229	            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   230	            intro p' _
   231	            calc
   232	              avgOver (uniformDistribution (K × K)) (fun coefficients =>
   233	                  if coefficients.1 * p.1 + coefficients.2 * p.2 =
   234	                      coefficients.1 * p'.1 + coefficients.2 * p'.2 then
   235	                    w p p' else 0) =
   236	                  avgOver (uniformDistribution (K × K)) (fun coefficients =>
   237	                    (if coefficients.1 * p.1 + coefficients.2 * p.2 =
   238	                        coefficients.1 * p'.1 + coefficients.2 * p'.2 then
   239	                      (1 : ℝ) else 0) * w p p') := by
   240	                        apply avgOver_congr
   241	                        intro coefficients
   242	                        split <;> simp_all
   243	              _ = (if p = p' then 1 else qinv) * w p p' := by
   244	                    rw [avgOver_mul_const, affine_collision_average]
   245	              _ = if p = p' then w p p' else qinv * w p p' := by
   246	                    split <;> simp_all
   247	    _ = (1 - qinv) * ∑ p, ‖v p‖ ^ 2 := by
   248	          calc
   249	            (∑ p, ∑ p', if p = p' then w p p' else qinv * w p p') =
   250	                qinv * (∑ p, ∑ p', w p p') + (1 - qinv) * ∑ p, w p p := by
   251	                  rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
   252	                  rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
   253	                  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   254	                  intro p _
   255	                  calc
   256	                    (∑ p', if p = p' then w p p' else qinv * w p p') =
   257	                        ∑ p', (qinv * w p p' +
   258	                          if p = p' then (1 - qinv) * w p p' else 0) := by
   259	                            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   260	                            intro p' _
   261	                            by_cases h : p = p' <;> simp [h]
   262	                            ring
   263	                    _ = qinv * ∑ p', w p p' + (1 - qinv) * w p p := by
   264	                          rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum]
   265	                          congr 1
   266	                          rw [Fintype.sum_eq_single p]
   267	                          · simp
   268	                          · intro p' hp'
   269	                            simp [Ne.symm hp']
   270	            _ = (1 - qinv) * ∑ p, ‖v p‖ ^ 2 := by rw [hall, hdiag]; ring
   271	    _ ≤ ∑ p, ‖v p‖ ^ 2 := by nlinarith

   273	/-- Uniform affine scalar coarse-graining does not increase the squared
   274	state-dependent distance of complete operator families. -/
   275	theorem opFamilyDistSq_uniform_affine_postprocess_le
   276	    {X K ι : Type} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Nonempty X]
   277	    [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
   278	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   279	    (A B : X → K × K → Op ι) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι)
   280	    (hsum : ∀ x, ∑ p, A x p = ∑ p, B x p) :
   281	    opFamilyDistSq (uniformDistribution (X × (K × K)))
   282	        (fun question c =>
   283	          ∑ p ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun p =>
   284	            question.2.1 * p.1 + question.2.2 * p.2 = c), A question.1 p)
   285	        (fun question c =>
   286	          ∑ p ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun p =>
   287	            question.2.1 * p.1 + question.2.2 * p.2 = c), B question.1 p)
   288	        ψ ≤ opFamilyDistSq (uniformDistribution X) A B ψ := by
   289	  classical
   290	  unfold opFamilyDistSq
   291	  calc
   292	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (X × (K × K))) (fun question =>
   293	        ∑ c : K,
   294	          ‖applyOperatorToState
   295	            ((∑ p ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun p =>
   296	                question.2.1 * p.1 + question.2.2 * p.2 = c), A question.1 p) -
   297	              ∑ p ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun p =>
   298	                question.2.1 * p.1 + question.2.2 * p.2 = c), B question.1 p) ψ‖ ^ 2) =
   299	        avgOver (uniformDistribution X) (fun x =>
   300	          avgOver (uniformDistribution (K × K)) (fun coefficients =>
   301	            ∑ c : K,
   302	              ‖applyOperatorToState
   303	                ((∑ p ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun p =>
   304	                    coefficients.1 * p.1 + coefficients.2 * p.2 = c), A x p) -
   305	                  ∑ p ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun p =>
   306	                    coefficients.1 * p.1 + coefficients.2 * p.2 = c), B x p) ψ‖ ^ 2)) := by
   307	          simpa only using (avgOver_uniform_prod (α := X) (β := K × K)
   308	            (fun x coefficients =>
   309	              ∑ c : K,
   310	                ‖applyOperatorToState
   311	                  ((∑ p ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun p =>
   312	                      coefficients.1 * p.1 + coefficients.2 * p.2 = c), A x p) -
   313	                    ∑ p ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun p =>
   314	                      coefficients.1 * p.1 + coefficients.2 * p.2 = c), B x p) ψ‖ ^ 2))
   315	    _ ≤ avgOver (uniformDistribution X) (fun x =>
   316	        ∑ p, ‖applyOperatorToState (A x p - B x p) ψ‖ ^ 2) := by
   317	      apply avgOver_mono
   318	      intro x
   319	      let v : K × K → EuclideanSpace ℂ ι := fun p =>
   320	        applyOperatorToState (A x p - B x p) ψ
   321	      have hvsum : ∑ p, v p = 0 := by
   322	        simp only [v]
   323	        calc
   324	          (∑ p, applyOperatorToState (A x p - B x p) ψ) =
   325	              applyOperatorToState (∑ p, (A x p - B x p)) ψ :=
   326	                (MagicSquareRigidity.applyOperatorToState_sum
   327	                  (fun p => A x p - B x p) ψ).symm
   328	          _ = 0 := by
   329	            rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hsum x, sub_self]
   330	            simp [applyOperatorToState]
   331	      calc
   332	        avgOver (uniformDistribution (K × K)) (fun coefficients =>
   333	            ∑ c : K,
   334	              ‖applyOperatorToState
   335	                ((∑ p ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun p =>
   336	                    coefficients.1 * p.1 + coefficients.2 * p.2 = c), A x p) -
   337	                  ∑ p ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun p =>
   338	                    coefficients.1 * p.1 + coefficients.2 * p.2 = c), B x p) ψ‖ ^ 2) =
   339	            avgOver (uniformDistribution (K × K)) (fun coefficients =>
   340	              ∑ c : K,
   341	                ‖∑ p ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun p =>
   342	                  coefficients.1 * p.1 + coefficients.2 * p.2 = c), v p‖ ^ 2) := by
   343	                  apply avgOver_congr
   344	                  intro coefficients
   345	                  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   346	                  intro c _
   347	                  congr 2
   348	                  simp only [v, applyOperatorToState, map_sub, LinearMap.sub_apply,
   349	                    map_sum, LinearMap.sum_apply, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
   350	        _ ≤ ∑ p, ‖v p‖ ^ 2 := avg_affine_fiber_norm_sq_le v hvsum
   351	        _ = ∑ p, ‖applyOperatorToState (A x p - B x p) ψ‖ ^ 2 := rfl

   353	/-- Register placement preserves the total of a finite operator family. -/
   354	theorem place_sum {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ}
   355	    (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) (p : Placement) {α : Type*} [Fintype α]
   356	    (A : α → Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p.side)) :
   357	    S.place p (∑ a, A a) = ∑ a, S.place p (A a) := by
   358	  classical
   359	  ext i j
   360	  cases p <;> simp [ProjectiveSetting.place, Matrix.sum_apply,
   361	    Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum]

   363	private theorem place_one {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ}
   364	    (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) (p : Placement) :
   365	    S.place p (1 : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p.side)) = 1 := by
   366	  ext i j
   367	  cases p <;> simp only [ProjectiveSetting.place, Matrix.one_apply, Prod.ext_iff]
   368	  all_goals split_ifs <;> aesop

   370	/-- A complete measurement remains complete after register placement. -/
   371	theorem sum_placed_measurement_eq_one {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ}
   372	    (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) (p : Placement) {α : Type*} [Fintype α]
   373	    (M : Measurement α (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p.side)) :
   374	    (∑ a, S.place p (M.effect a)) = 1 := by
   375	  rw [← place_sum, M.sum_eq_one, place_one]

   377	/-- Ordered products of two complete measurements have total identity after placement. -/
   378	theorem sum_placed_measurement_products_eq_one
   379	    {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ}
   380	    (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) (p : Placement)
   381	    {α β : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype β]
   382	    (M : Measurement α (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p.side))
   383	    (N : Measurement β (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p.side)) :
   384	    (∑ ab : α × β, S.place p (M.effect ab.1 * N.effect ab.2)) = 1 := by
   385	  rw [← place_sum, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
   386	  have hlocal : (∑ a : α, ∑ b : β, M.effect a * N.effect b) = 1 := by
   387	    calc
   388	    (∑ a : α, ∑ b : β, M.effect a * N.effect b) =
   389	        ∑ a : α, M.effect a * ∑ b : β, N.effect b := by
   390	          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   391	          intro a _
   392	          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
   393	    _ = (∑ a : α, M.effect a) * ∑ b : β, N.effect b := by rw [Finset.sum_mul]
   394	    _ = 1 := by rw [M.sum_eq_one, N.sum_eq_one, one_mul]
   395	  rw [hlocal, place_one]

    39	/-- Identify the direct extended game's scalar field with the Pauli scalar
    40	field.  Both are selected by `fixedFieldModel`; only their proof argument for
    41	admissibility differs. -/
    42	noncomputable def extendedDirectScalarEquiv (P : AdmissibleParams) :
    43	    DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd ≃+* PauliScalar P := by
    44	  have h : P.extendedDirectLd.hq = P.hq := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    45	  cases h
    46	  exact RingEquiv.refl _

    48	/-- Transport an extended direct point into the canonical Pauli scalar field. -/
    49	def directPointToPauli (P : AdmissibleParams)
    50	    (u : Fin P.extendedDirectLd.m -> DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd) :
    51	    Fin (2 * P.m + 2) -> PauliScalar P :=
    52	  fun i => extendedDirectScalarEquiv P (u i)

    56	/-- A finite code for directly indexed lines, omitting only proof fields. -/
    57	private abbrev DirectLineDescCode (D : DirectLdParams) :=
    58	  ((Fin D.m -> DirectScalarQ D) × Fin D.m) ⊕
    59	    ((Fin D.m -> DirectScalarQ D) × Fin D.m ×
    60	      (Fin D.m -> DirectScalarQ D))

    62	/-- Encode a directly indexed line by its tag and mathematical data. -/
    63	private def directLineDescCode (D : DirectLdParams) :
    64	    DirectLineDesc D -> DirectLineDescCode D
    65	  | .axis base index _ => .inl (base, index)
    66	  | .diagonal base index direction _ _ => .inr (base, index, direction)
    67	
    68	/-- The direct-line code is injective by proof irrelevance. -/
    69	private theorem directLineDescCode_injective (D : DirectLdParams) :
    70	    Function.Injective (directLineDescCode D) := by
    71	  intro line line' h
    72	  cases line with
    73	  | axis base index baseFixed =>
    74	      cases line' with
    75	      | axis base' index' baseFixed' =>
    76	          simp only [directLineDescCode, Sum.inl.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at h
    77	          rcases h with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    78	          rfl
    79	      | diagonal => simp [directLineDescCode] at h
    80	  | diagonal base index direction baseFixed prefixZero =>
    81	      cases line' with
    82	      | axis => simp [directLineDescCode] at h
    83	      | diagonal base' index' direction' baseFixed' prefixZero' =>
    84	          simp only [directLineDescCode, Sum.inr.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at h
    85	          rcases h with ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
    86	          rfl

    94	
    95	/-- Projective joint point measurements and their ordered consistency
    96	guarantees from `lem:qld-4-10`, paper lines 689--709.  The `XZ` and `ZX`
    97	products are retained as distinct fields. -/
    98	structure CombinedPointsWitness {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ}
    99	    (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) (δ : ℝ) where
   100	  /-- The complete joint measurement on each player's expanded local space. -/
   101	  Q : (side : PlayerSide) ->
   102	    (Fin P.m -> PauliScalar P) ->
   103	    (Fin P.m -> PauliScalar P) ->
   104	    Measurement (PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P) (S.ExpandedLocalSpace side)
   105	  /-- Every joint point measurement is projective. -/
   106	  projective : ∀ side x z, Measurement.IsProjective (Q side x z)
   107	  /-- Joint point measurements agree across every directed opposite placement. -/
   108	  self_consistent : ∀ p1 p2 : Placement, p1.IsOpposite p2 ->
   109	    opFamilyDistSq
   110	      (uniformDistribution
   111	        ((Fin P.m -> PauliScalar P) × (Fin P.m -> PauliScalar P)))
   112	      (fun xz ab => S.place p1 ((Q p1.side xz.1 xz.2).effect ab))
   113	      (fun xz ab => S.place p2 ((Q p2.side xz.1 xz.2).effect ab))
   114	      S.psiHat <= δ
   115	  /-- Joint point measurements are close to the ordered `X`-then-`Z` product. -/
   116	  consistent_XZ : ∀ p1 p2 : Placement, p1.IsOpposite p2 ->
   117	    opFamilyDistSq
   118	      (uniformDistribution
   119	        ((Fin P.m -> PauliScalar P) × (Fin P.m -> PauliScalar P)))
   120	      (fun xz ab => S.place p1 ((Q p1.side xz.1 xz.2).effect ab))
   121	      (fun xz ab => S.place p2
   122	        ((S.pointMeasExp p2.side .X xz.1).effect ab.1 *
   123	          (S.pointMeasExp p2.side .Z xz.2).effect ab.2))
   124	      S.psiHat <= δ
   125	  /-- Joint point measurements are close to the ordered `Z`-then-`X` product. -/
   126	  consistent_ZX : ∀ p1 p2 : Placement, p1.IsOpposite p2 ->
   127	    opFamilyDistSq
   128	      (uniformDistribution
   129	        ((Fin P.m -> PauliScalar P) × (Fin P.m -> PauliScalar P)))
   130	      (fun xz ab => S.place p1 ((Q p1.side xz.1 xz.2).effect ab))
   131	      (fun xz ab => S.place p2
   132	        ((S.pointMeasExp p2.side .Z xz.2).effect ab.2 *
   133	          (S.pointMeasExp p2.side .X xz.1).effect ab.1))
   134	      S.psiHat <= δ

   136	/-- Joint line measurements and their evaluation consistency from
   137	`lem:qld-xz-lines`, paper lines 882--894.  Evaluation uses explicit `Option`
   138	outcomes, including the class of answers not determined at the sampled point. -/
   139	structure CombinedLinesWitness {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε δQ : ℝ}
   140	    (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) (points : CombinedPointsWitness S δQ)
   141	    (δ : ℝ) where
   142	  /-- The complete paired-line measurement on each expanded local space. -/
   143	  T : (side : PlayerSide) ->
   144	    LineDesc P.toLdParams -> LineDesc P.toLdParams ->
   145	    Measurement
   146	      (DegPoly P.toLdParams (P.m * P.d) ×
   147	        DegPoly P.toLdParams (P.m * P.d))
   148	      (S.ExpandedLocalSpace side)
   149	  /-- On an axis-parallel X line, outcomes outside degree `d` have zero effect. -/
   150	  axis_degree_X : ∀ side lineX lineZ fX fZ,
   151	    lineX.kind = .axis -> Not (DegPoly.FitsDegree P.d fX) ->
   152	      (T side lineX lineZ).effect (fX, fZ) = 0
   153	  /-- On an axis-parallel Z line, outcomes outside degree `d` have zero effect. -/
   154	  axis_degree_Z : ∀ side lineX lineZ fX fZ,
   155	    lineZ.kind = .axis -> Not (DegPoly.FitsDegree P.d fZ) ->
   156	      (T side lineX lineZ).effect (fX, fZ) = 0
   157	  /-- Evaluated line pairs are consistent with the completed point-pair
   158	  measurement on every directed opposite placement. -/
   159	  consistent : ∀ p1 p2 : Placement, p1.IsOpposite p2 ->
   160	    consistencyDefect
   161	      (Distribution.prod (linePointDist P.toLdParams)
   162	        (linePointDist P.toLdParams))
   163	      (fun sample answer => S.place p1
   164	        (((T p1.side sample.1.1 sample.2.1).postprocess fun fs =>
   165	          (evalOpt sample.1.1 sample.1.2 fs.1,
   166	            evalOpt sample.2.1 sample.2.2 fs.2)).effect answer))
   167	      (fun sample answer => S.place p2
   168	        (((points.Q p2.side sample.1.2 sample.2.2).postprocess fun ab =>
   169	          (some ab.1, some ab.2)).effect answer))
   170	      S.psiHat <= δ

   172	/-! ## The subline distribution -/
   173	
   174	/-- A tuple consisting of an extended line and its projected X and Z lines. -/
   175	abbrev SubLineTriple (P : AdmissibleParams) :=
   176	  DirectLineDesc P.extendedDirectLd ×
   177	    (LineDesc P.toLdParams × LineDesc P.toLdParams)
   178	
   179	/-- An extended line tuple together with a point sampled uniformly on it. -/
   180	abbrev SubLinePointSample (P : AdmissibleParams) :=
   181	  SubLineTriple P ×
   182	    (Fin P.extendedDirectLd.m -> DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd)
   183	
   184	/-- The shared restricted line kind and two coordinate indices in one mixture
   185	component of the subline law. -/
   186	abbrev SubLineComponent (P : AdmissibleParams) :=
   187	  LineKind × (Fin P.m × Fin P.m)
   188	
   189	/-- Select the restricted line-point distribution of a given kind and index. -/
   190	noncomputable def restrictedLinePointDist (P : AdmissibleParams)
   191	    (kind : LineKind) (i : Fin P.m) :
   192	    Distribution (LineDesc P.toLdParams × (Fin P.m -> PauliScalar P)) :=
   193	  match kind with
   194	  | .axis => restrictedALineDist P.toLdParams i
   195	  | .diagonal => restrictedDLineDist P.toLdParams i
   196	
   197	/-- Sample a subline tuple and then a uniform affine parameter on its
   198	extended line. -/
   199	noncomputable def subLinePointDist (P : AdmissibleParams)
   200	    (D : Distribution (SubLineTriple P)) :
   201	    Distribution (SubLinePointSample P) :=
   202	  (Distribution.prod D
   203	    (uniformDistribution (DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd))).map fun sample =>
   204	      (sample.1, sample.1.1.base + sample.2 • sample.1.1.direction)
   205	
   206	/-- Retain the projected line pair and the X projection of an extended point. -/
   207	def subLineXProjection {P : AdmissibleParams} (sample : SubLinePointSample P) :
   208	    (LineDesc P.toLdParams × LineDesc P.toLdParams) ×
   209	      (Fin P.m -> PauliScalar P) :=
   210	  (sample.1.2, projX (directPointToPauli P sample.2))
   211	
   212	/-- Retain the projected line pair and the Z projection of an extended point. -/
   213	def subLineZProjection {P : AdmissibleParams} (sample : SubLinePointSample P) :
   214	    (LineDesc P.toLdParams × LineDesc P.toLdParams) ×
   215	      (Fin P.m -> PauliScalar P) :=
   216	  (sample.1.2, projZ (directPointToPauli P sample.2))
   217	
   218	/-- The X-point marginal associated with one restricted product component. -/
   219	noncomputable def subLineXComponentDist (P : AdmissibleParams)
   220	    (component : SubLineComponent P) :
   221	    Distribution
   222	      ((LineDesc P.toLdParams × LineDesc P.toLdParams) ×
   223	        (Fin P.m -> PauliScalar P)) :=
   224	  (Distribution.prod
   225	    (restrictedLinePointDist P component.1 component.2.1)
   226	    ((restrictedLinePointDist P component.1 component.2.2).map Prod.fst)).map
   227	      fun sample => ((sample.1.1, sample.2), sample.1.2)
   228	
   229	/-- The Z-point marginal associated with one restricted product component. -/
   230	noncomputable def subLineZComponentDist (P : AdmissibleParams)
   231	    (component : SubLineComponent P) :
   232	    Distribution
   233	      ((LineDesc P.toLdParams × LineDesc P.toLdParams) ×
   234	        (Fin P.m -> PauliScalar P)) :=
   235	  (Distribution.prod
   236	    ((restrictedLinePointDist P component.1 component.2.1).map Prod.fst)
   237	    (restrictedLinePointDist P component.1 component.2.2)).map
   238	      fun sample => ((sample.1, sample.2.1), sample.2.2)
   239	
   240	/-- Directly indexed form of the subline distribution of `lem:qld-sublines`,
   241	paper lines 1063--1069.  Its extended-line marginal is the directly indexed
   242	line-point law rather than the seed-indexed line-point distribution over
   243	`F_q^(2m+2)` of the source statement; that replacement is documented in
   244	`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-dimension-divisibility.tex`, so this is a
   245	formalization auxiliary record, not the source-labelled statement.  Its
   246	source-mixture field records the X and Z point marginals separately; it does
   247	not assert a joint conditional law for the pair of projected points. -/
   248	structure SubLineWitness (P : AdmissibleParams) where
   249	  /-- The actual distribution of an extended line and two projected lines. -/
   250	  D : Distribution (SubLineTriple P)
   251	  /-- The distribution has total mass one. -/
   252	  isProbability : D.IsProbability
   253	  /-- Its extended-line marginal is the direct line-point marginal. -/
   254	  extended_marginal : D.map Prod.fst =
   255	    (directLinePointDist P.extendedDirectLd).map Prod.fst
   256	  /-- Every point of an extended line projects onto both stored source lines. -/
   257	  incidence : ∀ sample ∈ D.support, ∀ u ∈ sample.1.pointSet,
   258	    projX (directPointToPauli P u) ∈ sample.2.1.pointSet ∧
   259	      projZ (directPointToPauli P u) ∈ sample.2.2.pointSet
   260	  /-- Each line triple carries affine data sufficient for
   261	  `combineLinePoly_spec`. -/
   262	  compatibility : ∀ sample ∈ D.support,
   263	    ∃ aX bX aZ bZ uAlpha vAlpha uBeta vBeta : PauliScalar P,
   264	      IsCombineLineCompatible
   265	        (directPointToPauli P sample.1.base)
   266	        (directPointToPauli P sample.1.direction)
   267	        sample.2.1.base sample.2.1.direction
   268	        sample.2.2.base sample.2.2.direction
   269	        aX bX aZ bZ uAlpha vAlpha uBeta vBeta
   270	  /-- Each one-point projected marginal is a mixture of restricted product
   271	  laws.  No equality for their joint conditional law is claimed. -/
   272	  source_mixture : ∃ components : Distribution (SubLineComponent P),
   273	    components.IsProbability ∧
   274	      (subLinePointDist P D).map subLineXProjection =
   275	        Distribution.bind components (subLineXComponentDist P) ∧
   276	      (subLinePointDist P D).map subLineZProjection =
   277	        Distribution.bind components (subLineZComponentDist P)
   278	  /-- An extended axis line has axis-parallel projected lines. -/
   279	  axis_closure : ∀ sample ∈ D.support, sample.1.kind = .axis ->
   280	    sample.2.1.kind = .axis ∧ sample.2.2.kind = .axis
   281	
   282	/-! ## Extended lines and global polynomial pairs -/
   283	
   284	/-- Extended-line POVMs and directly indexed, completed-answer forms of the two
   285	consistency relations in `lem:qld-4-13`, paper lines 1020--1034. The direct line
   286	carrier avoids the dimension-divisibility obstruction documented in
   287	`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-dimension-divisibility.tex`. -/
   288	structure ExtendedLinesWitness {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε δQ : ℝ}
   289	    (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) (points : CombinedPointsWitness S δQ)
   290	    (δ : ℝ) where
   291	  /-- The complete extended-line measurement on each player side. -/
   292	  Qline : (side : PlayerSide) -> DirectLineDesc P.extendedDirectLd ->
   293	    Measurement (DirectDegPoly P.extendedDirectLd (P.m * P.d + 1))
   294	      (S.ExpandedLocalSpace side)
   295	  /-- Axis-line outcomes outside degree `d` have zero effect. -/
   296	  axis_degree : ∀ side line f, line.kind = .axis ->
   297	    Not (∀ i, P.d < i.val -> f i = 0) ->
   298	      (Qline side line).effect f = 0
   299	  /-- Alice's evaluated line measurement is consistent with Bob's completed
   300	  combined point measurement. -/
   301	  consistent_alice : consistencyDefect
   302	    (directLinePointDist P.extendedDirectLd)
   303	    (fun sample answer => S.place .AA'
   304	      (((Qline .alice sample.1).postprocess
   305	        (fun f => (directEvalOpt sample.1 sample.2 f).map
   306	          (extendedDirectScalarEquiv P))).effect answer))
   307	    (fun sample answer => S.place .BA''
   308	      (((points.Q .bob
   309	        (projX (directPointToPauli P sample.2))
   310	        (projZ (directPointToPauli P sample.2))).postprocess fun ab =>
   311	          some (directPointToPauli P sample.2 (alphaVar P.m) * ab.1 +
   312	            directPointToPauli P sample.2 (betaVar P.m) * ab.2)).effect answer))
   313	    S.psiHat <= δ
   314	  /-- Bob's evaluated line measurement is consistent with Alice's completed
   315	  combined point measurement. -/
   316	  consistent_bob : consistencyDefect
   317	    (directLinePointDist P.extendedDirectLd)
   318	    (fun sample answer => S.place .BB'
   319	      (((Qline .bob sample.1).postprocess
   320	        (fun f => (directEvalOpt sample.1 sample.2 f).map
   321	          (extendedDirectScalarEquiv P))).effect answer))
   322	    (fun sample answer => S.place .AB''
   323	      (((points.Q .alice
   324	        (projX (directPointToPauli P sample.2))
   325	        (projZ (directPointToPauli P sample.2))).postprocess fun ab =>
   326	          some (directPointToPauli P sample.2 (alphaVar P.m) * ab.1 +
   327	            directPointToPauli P sample.2 (betaVar P.m) * ab.2)).effect answer))
   328	    S.psiHat <= δ
   329	
   330	/-- The side-indexed global polynomial-pair measurements handed to Chapter 16.
   331	This is the exact conclusion of `lem:qld-4-7`, paper lines 1267--1274, with
   332	the two heterogeneous point-consistency displays stated separately. -/
   333	structure GlobalPairWitness {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ}
   334	    (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) (δ : ℝ) where
   335	  /-- The complete global polynomial-pair measurement on each player side. -/
   336	  Smeas : (side : PlayerSide) ->
   337	    Measurement (PolyPair P) (S.ExpandedLocalSpace side)
   338	  /-- Both global polynomial-pair measurements are projective. -/
   339	  projective : ∀ side, Measurement.IsProjective (Smeas side)
   340	  /-- Alice's global evaluations are consistent with Bob's source point
   341	  measurements, for each Pauli basis. -/
   342	  point_consistent_alice : ∀ W : PauliKind,
   343	    consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m -> PauliScalar P))
   344	      (fun u a => S.place .AA'
   345	        (((Smeas .alice).postprocess (evalAt W u)).effect a))
   346	      (fun u a => S.place .BA''
   347	        ((S.pointMeasExp .bob W u).effect a))
   348	      S.psiHat <= δ
   349	  /-- Bob's global evaluations are consistent with Alice's source point
   350	  measurements, for each Pauli basis. -/
   351	  point_consistent_bob : ∀ W : PauliKind,
   352	    consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m -> PauliScalar P))
   353	      (fun u a => S.place .BB'
   354	        (((Smeas .bob).postprocess (evalAt W u)).effect a))
   355	      (fun u a => S.place .AB''
   356	        ((S.pointMeasExp .alice W u).effect a))
   357	      S.psiHat <= δ
   358	
   359	end

     4	/-!
     5	# A direct-game strategy from supplied extended-line measurements
     6	
     7	The input is an existing `ExtendedLinesWitness`, not an existence assertion
     8	for that witness. Axis answers are restricted using its degree-support field;
     9	diagonal answers are extended by zero coefficients. Point answers are the
    10	scalar coarse-grainings of the supplied joint point measurements.
    11	
    12	These are construction lemmas for the first paragraph of the proof of
    13	`lem:qld-4-7`, not a proof of that lemma or of the existence of its input.
    14	The remaining game-value estimates and the dependency on issue #119 are
    15	recorded in `audits/2026-09-06_extended-line-game-244.md`.
    16	
    17	## References
    18	
    19	- `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1020-1034`
    20	- `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1267-1402`
    21	- Blueprint `lem:qld-4-7` and `rem:qld-4-7-divisibility`.
    22	- `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-dimension-divisibility.tex`
    23	-/

    36	/-- Successful completed evaluation means evaluation at every parameter
    37	presenting the point, including when the line direction is zero. -/
    38	theorem directEvalOpt_eq_some_iff {params : DirectLdParams} {degree : ℕ}
    39	    (line : DirectLineDesc params) (point : Fin params.m → DirectScalarQ params)
    40	    (coeffs : DirectDegPoly params degree) (answer : DirectScalarQ params) :
    41	    directEvalOpt line point coeffs = some answer ↔
    42	      DirectEvaluatesTo line coeffs point answer := by
    43	  classical
    44	  unfold directEvalOpt
    45	  split_ifs with hexists
    46	  · simp only [Option.some.injEq]
    47	    constructor
    48	    · intro heq
    49	      simpa [heq] using Classical.choose_spec hexists
    50	    · intro heval
    51	      obtain ⟨parameter, hparameter⟩ := heval.1
    52	      exact ((Classical.choose_spec hexists).2 parameter hparameter).symm.trans
    53	        (heval.2 parameter hparameter)
    54	  · simp only [false_iff]
    55	    exact fun heval => hexists ⟨answer, heval⟩
    56	
    57	/-- The axis answer length fits inside the extended-line coefficient list. -/
    58	theorem axis_degree_le (params : AdmissibleParams) :
    59	    params.d + 1 ≤ params.m * params.d + 2 := by
    60	  have hmul := Nat.mul_le_mul_right params.d params.one_le_m
    61	  omega
    62	
    63	/-- Restrict an extended-line answer to the axis degree bound. -/
    64	def axisRead (params : AdmissibleParams)
    65	    (coeffs : DirectDegPoly params.extendedDirectLd (params.m * params.d + 1)) :
    66	    DirectDegPoly params.extendedDirectLd params.d :=
    67	  fun index => coeffs (Fin.castLE (axis_degree_le params) index)
    68	
    69	/-- Restriction preserves evaluation when the discarded coefficients vanish. -/
    70	theorem axisRead_eval (params : AdmissibleParams)
    71	    (coeffs : DirectDegPoly params.extendedDirectLd (params.m * params.d + 1))
    72	    (hsupport : ∀ index, params.d < index.val → coeffs index = 0)
    73	    (parameter : DirectScalarQ params.extendedDirectLd) :
    74	      evalCoefficient (axisRead params coeffs) parameter = evalCoefficient coeffs parameter := by
    75	  unfold evalCoefficient axisRead
    76	  refine Fintype.sum_of_injective (Fin.castLE (axis_degree_le params))
    77	    (Fin.castLE_injective _) _ (fun index => coeffs index * parameter ^ index.val)
    78	    ?_ (fun _ => rfl)
    79	  intro index hindex
    80	  have hlarge : params.d < index.val := by
    81	    by_contra hlarge
    82	    exact hindex ⟨⟨index.val, by omega⟩, Fin.ext rfl⟩
    83	  simp [hsupport index hlarge]
    84	
    85	/-- The extended-line degree fits the direct game's diagonal answer bound. -/
    86	theorem diagonal_degree_le (params : AdmissibleParams) :
    87	    params.m * params.d + 2 ≤
    88	      params.extendedDirectLd.m * params.extendedDirectLd.d + 1 := by
    89	  change params.m * params.d + 2 ≤ (2 * params.m + 2) * params.d + 1
    90	  have hdegree := params.hd
    91	  nlinarith

    93	/-- Extend a diagonal-line coefficient list by zeros, without changing its polynomial. -/
    94	def diagonalRead (params : AdmissibleParams)
    95	    (coeffs : DirectDegPoly params.extendedDirectLd (params.m * params.d + 1)) :
    96	    DirectDegPoly params.extendedDirectLd
    97	      (params.extendedDirectLd.m * params.extendedDirectLd.d) :=
    98	  fun index => if bound : index.val < params.m * params.d + 2
    99	    then coeffs ⟨index.val, bound⟩ else 0
   100	
   101	/-- Extending a diagonal answer by zeros preserves evaluation at every parameter. -/
   102	theorem diagonalRead_eval (params : AdmissibleParams)
   103	    (coeffs : DirectDegPoly params.extendedDirectLd (params.m * params.d + 1))
   104	    (parameter : DirectScalarQ params.extendedDirectLd) :
   105	    evalCoefficient (diagonalRead params coeffs) parameter =
   106	      evalCoefficient coeffs parameter := by
   107	  symm
   108	  apply Fintype.sum_of_injective (Fin.castLE (diagonal_degree_le params))
   109	    (Fin.castLE_injective _) _ _ ?_ ?_
   110	  · intro index hindex
   111	    have hlarge : ¬index.val < params.m * params.d + 2 := by
   112	      intro hsmall
   113	      exact hindex ⟨⟨index.val, hsmall⟩, Fin.ext rfl⟩
   114	    simp [diagonalRead, hlarge]
   115	  · intro index
   116	    simp [diagonalRead, index.isLt]

   135	/-- Re-reading a canonical axis question preserves its line description. -/
   136	theorem axis_description_canonical (params : DirectLdParams) (sample : DirectLdSpace params) :
   137	    directALineDescOf params (directLdMap params .aline sample) =
   138	      directALineDescOf params sample := by
   139	  simp [directALineDescOf, directLdMap, lineRepMap_apply_self]
   140	
   141	/-- Re-reading a canonical diagonal question preserves its line description,
   142	also for zero directions. -/
   143	theorem diagonal_description_canonical (params : DirectLdParams)
   144	    (sample : DirectLdSpace params) :
   145	    directDLineDescOf params (directLdMap params .dline sample) =
   146	      directDLineDescOf params sample := by
   147	  have hprefix : directPrefixProjection sample.index
   148	      (directPrefixProjection sample.index sample.direction) =
   149	        directPrefixProjection sample.index sample.direction := by
   150	    funext index
   151	    by_cases hindex : index.val < sample.index.val <;> simp [directPrefixProjection, hindex]
   152	  simp [directDLineDescOf, directLdMap, hprefix, lineRepMap_apply_self]
   153	
   154	/-- On degree-supported outcomes, the axis verifier checks precisely successful
   155	completed evaluation, after the canonical field transport. -/
   156	theorem axisAnswer_win_iff (params : AdmissibleParams)
   157	    (sample : DirectLdSpace params.extendedDirectLd)
   158	    (coeffs : DirectDegPoly params.extendedDirectLd (params.m * params.d + 1))
   159	    (hsupport : ∀ index, params.d < index.val → coeffs index = 0)
   160	    (answer : DirectScalarQ params.extendedDirectLd) :
   161	    directLdWinPredicate params.extendedDirectLd
   162	      (.aline, directLdMap params.extendedDirectLd .aline sample)
   163	      (.point, directLdMap params.extendedDirectLd .point sample)
   164	      (axisAnswer params coeffs) (pointAnswer params ((extendedDirectScalarEquiv params) answer)) =
   165	        true ↔ directEvalOpt (directALineDescOf params.extendedDirectLd sample)
   166	          sample.point coeffs = some answer := by
   167	  rw [directEvalOpt_eq_some_iff]
   168	  simp only [directLdWinPredicate, axisAnswer, pointAnswer, validDirectLdAnswer,
   169	    Bool.and_self, ↓reduceIte, decide_eq_true_eq,

     5	# Consistency of direct coefficient measurements
     6	
     7	This module lifts consistency of uniformly evaluated coefficient-vector POVMs
     8	to consistency of their full coefficient outcomes.  The loss is the direct
     9	univariate collision bound `degree / q`.

    12	
    13	- `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:331-344`
    14	- `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1595-1603`

    16	-/

    18	open scoped BigOperators MatrixOrder Matrix ComplexOrder
    19	
    20	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
    21	
    22	open MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
    23	open MIPStarRE.Quantum
